description_en: Creates a network optimization configuration for a site
description_zh: 新增站点网络优化配置
name: CreateNetworkOptimization

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The name of the rule. You do not need to specify this parameter when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. You do not need to specify this parameter when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The content of the rule. It uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to specify this parameter when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq "video.example.com")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the smart routing service. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启智能路由服务，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启
off：关闭
parameters.name: smart_routing

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2 back-to-origin. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HTTP2回源，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启
off：关闭
parameters.name: http2_origin

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable WebSocket. Default value: on. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启Websocket，默认开启。取值范围：
on：开启
off：关闭
parameters.name: websocket

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable gRPC. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启GRPC，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启
off：关闭
parameters.name: grpc

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of an uploaded file. Unit: MB. Valid values: 100 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 最大上传文件大小，单位是MB，取值范围：100～500
parameters.name: upload_max_filesize

parameters.help_en: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
